intended_behavior: Add a new parameter concurrent_invocation_mode of type ConcurrentInvocationMode (Literal["throw", "unsafe_reentrant"]) with default "throw". Store it as self._concurrent_invocation_mode. Update the method docstring accordingly, preserving all existing functionality.

Modify the locking acquisition to be conditional on self._concurrent_invocation_mode. Acquire the lock only if mode == "throw". If mode == "unsafe_reentrant", skip locking and allow concurrent invocations without raising ConcurrencyException. Preserve all other logic of the method.
Add a new type alias ConcurrentInvocationMode = Literal["throw", "unsafe_reentrant"] for better typing and reuse.

Add tests covering concurrent invocation scenarios for both modes of concurrent_invocation_mode to verify that in "unsafe_reentrant" mode concurrent invocations do not raise exceptions and function correctly, and in "throw" mode the existing behavior of raising ConcurrencyException is preserved.
